I'm a Junior at Columbia Universty majoring in computer science and minoring in mathematics. I am most experienced in the fields of computer graphics, cyber security, and systems programming, however I enjoy all forms of coding! Thank you for visiting Bea Dot Com!
You can reach me at beatricestotz@gmail.com or at 571-969-9951

Coursework Computer Graphics Writing a raytracer and rasterizer to achieve high quality shading and lighting in a virutal 3D environment Implementing a skeleton using forward kinematics to animate the skeleton with linear blend skinning Geometric modeling using spline curves Advanced Systems Programming Implementing Unix libraries and tools (malloc, grep, debugger, linker) Advanced I/O, piping, multiplexing Basics of linux container system C++ Deep Dive for C Programmers Introduction to C++, discussing how C++ was built from C Implementing STL sequence containers, inheritance, and polymorphism, Template meta programming and functional programming Advanced Programming Introduction to C, Unix fundamentals, and networking Implementing a database lookup server Introduction to Databases Fundamentals of database design and application development using databases Entity-relationship modeling, logical design of relational databases, SQL Creating and hosting a database in psql using google cloud services Fundamentals of Computer Systems Digital logic design and optimization Processor design and assembly language Basics of computer architecture Data Structures in Java Introduction to higher level data structures in Java (hash maps, trees, linked lists, etc) Overview and implementation of sorting algorithms

Dire Date Night demo out now! You’re 15 minutes late to a blind date with a girl that you have absolutely no chemistry with. Also she’s secretly a werewolf. Navigate awkward conversations and touchy subjects with your stone-faced date, and if you’re lucky you might be able to salvage the night
Visit the itch.io page to play!
Created using RenPy. All programming and art by me, dialogue written with the help of Valerie Katsumi.
Dire Date Night main menu Timed dialogue options Try not to scare off your date

Research Project Lead Columbia University Geometry Lab Leading project to visualize rock climbing walls in virtual reality with ML generated climbing paths Wrote program in python to generate random seed-based rock climbing walls and sample a point clouds of those walls to imitate a real-world scanner with a simulated camera Training PointNet ML model to process a point cloud and assign labels to each point, with the goal of recognizing specific holds on a novel rock climbing wall Vizualization of the point cloud sampled from randomly generated rock climbing wall in polyscope Cyber Intern Protek Information Technology Services Worked on the Deloitte-Protek NYSOC team to explore and evaluate the Google SecOps test environment for platform migration, reviewing the SIEM and SOAR environments for analyst use As part of my evaluation of the platform, I created use cases and playbooks in SecOps test environment to simulate the day to day needs of a security analyst from a SIEM environment At the end of my internship, I delivered a presentation with all of my findings compiled for the team to decide whether or not to migrate to the Google SecOps environment. The presentation was later adapted for client use.
